title: long-haul
objective: Full sun-ruins play-through to the finale on the real model: every anchor reached, convergence honoured, success-criteria hooks recorded. Expensive — run at plan 01 (baseline) and plan 07/08 (acceptance) only.

checks.goal: cp1 → cp2: the player approaches the job board

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

send_generate.text: I push through the crowd and get close to the job board to read the postings.
I read the Sun Ruins notice aloud to Arin, tracing the seal with a finger.
"This one — the Sun Ruins job." I stay at the board, pointing at the notice.

checks.goal: cp2 → cp3: the party accepts the Sun Ruins mission

send_generate.text: "We'll take it," I tell Ponticius, and I accept the Sun Ruins mission on the spot.
I take the Sun Ruins contract from Ponticius and sign it.

checks.goal: cp3 → cp-4a: the player agrees to bring Luke along

send_generate.text: Luke begs to come with us. I agree to bring Luke on the expedition.
"Fine — Luke comes with us." I sling his pack over my shoulder and we set out.

checks.goal: cp-4a → cp-4a1: the sphinx riddle is answered correctly

send_generate.text: I face the sphinx and answer its riddle: "The moon."
"My answer is the moon," I repeat to the sphinx, meeting its gaze.

checks.goal: cp-4a1 → cp-5: the party enters the inner chamber, and convergence progress is recorded

send_generate.text: We step past the archway and enter the chamber of ancient machinery.
We walk into the chamber and start examining the machinery inside.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const rows = rt.getSnapshot().convergence ?? []; const row = rows.find((entry) => entry.anchorId === 'cp-6'); if (!row) throw new Error('no convergence row for cp-6: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); if (!(row.progress >= 1)) throw new Error('cp-6 recorded no convergence progress: ' + JSON.stringify(row)); return { anchor: row.anchorId, progress: row.progress, threshold: row.threshold };

checks.goal: cp-5 → cp-6: the artifact is secured and the party returns to the guild

send_generate.text: I lift the Sun's Heart from its pedestal and secure the artifact in my pack.
"Back to Xentar." We head back to the guild with the artifact.
We carry the artifact back through the ruins and into the guild hall at Xentar.

checks.goal: every anchor was visited and none was skipped

steps.eval: const visited = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState().visitedAnchors; const want = ['cp1', 'cp2', 'cp3', 'cp-5', 'cp-6']; const missing = want.filter((id) => !visited.includes(id)); if (missing.length) throw new Error(`anchors skipped: ${missing.join(', ')} (visited ${visited.join(', ')})`); return visited;

checks.goal: the long session left a coherent journal and memory behind

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const events = rt.getSessionJournal(); const kinds = new Set(events.map((e) => e.kind)); const transitions = events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'transition').length; if (transitions < 5) throw new Error(`expected 5+ transition events, got ${transitions}`); const memory = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.length; if (!memory) throw new Error('no memory entries after a full play-through'); return { events: events.length, transitions, memory, kinds: [...kinds] };

checks.prompt: Over the whole play-through, did the story feel authored — arriving where it was meant to — or did it feel like it was dragging you along rails?
checks.anchors: 1 = pure rails · 3 = authored but visible machinery · 5 = felt like a GM running my choices

checks.prompt: Did the finale land, given what actually happened in your run?
checks.anchors: 1 = disconnected from my choices · 3 = generic ending · 5 = paid off my run specifically
